title: 有馬記念(クラシック)にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen—a race where the competitors are decided on by the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan's achievements in the Classics have been well received, and she's earned her place here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen! You'll be running in the Arima Kinen too, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I worked myself too hard leading up to the Kikuka Sho. Thus, I will be dedicating myself to preparing for next year's important races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, good day. I hope you enjoy this gathering of monstrous racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Monstrous racers… Is she referring to the seniors running in the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Th-that's… Oguri Cap! The one everyone says is in the "Beast" class.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Everyone knows her. She's a super famous megastar…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so popular… And just look at that aura she puts out…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh, y-yeah… I just realized what a crazy place I've come to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Until now, going to the Classics and racing McQueen was my everything. But there's so much more out there besides that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen… So this is the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: Do you think you'll be okay?
Do you think you'll be okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, o-of course! I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But… I'm pretty scared. Oguri is—no, it's not just Oguri. The competition here is endless…
